description: ERC-8262 provider protocol vectors (SPEC.md section 10). Fixtures only: no Oracle is deployed, every address, root and signer hash is illustrative, and wallets are PUBLIC Hardhat/Anvil TEST addresses. `discovery` and `evidence` documents all validate against their schemas; `schemaCases` all fail; `evaluationCases` and `quorumCases` reproduce the section 10.5 and 10.6 algorithms. `context.allowlist` is the consumer's pin of each trust domain to its attestor; `context.discoveryFetch` / `context.evidenceFetch` give the host each document came from and the HTTP status (a non-200 evidence fetch evaluates no document); `context.registry` stands in for the consumer's Oracle reads; `context.seenDiscovery` / `context.seenEvidence` name documents the consumer observed earlier. `limits` carries the protocol constants; `refusals` lists the refusals in check order.

schemaCases.name: discovery-native-two-sources
schemaCases.description: A native trust domain is one source.

schemaCases.name: discovery-single-label-trust-domain
schemaCases.description: trustDomainId is a DNS host with at least two labels.

schemaCases.name: discovery-attestor-not-decimal-string
schemaCases.description: attestorProviderId is a uint256 decimal string, never a JSON number.

schemaCases.name: discovery-key-without-material
schemaCases.description: A credential-root key names its credentialSigner.

schemaCases.name: discovery-carries-points
schemaCases.description: Scoring is the consumer's: no points, category or tier fields.

schemaCases.name: evidence-carries-points
schemaCases.description: Scoring is the consumer's: no points, category or tier fields.

schemaCases.name: evidence-credential-without-root
schemaCases.description: A proof type 4 artifact names its credential root.

schemaCases.name: evidence-guessable-id
schemaCases.description: evidenceId carries at least 128 bits (22 base64url characters).

schemaCases.name: evidence-unknown-protocol-version
schemaCases.description: A consumer refuses a version it does not implement.

schemaCases.name: discovery-too-many-keys
schemaCases.description: At most 32 keys (likewise deployments, sources and claims per source).

evaluationCases.name: native-accepted
evaluationCases.description: Native trust domain, Base Sepolia, current key, root registered to attestor 7.

evaluationCases.name: gateway-accepted-base
evaluationCases.description: Gateway trust domain on Base: differs from native-accepted in source, trust domain, attestor, policy, expiry, chain and Oracle.

evaluationCases.name: gateway-human-tech-accepted
evaluationCases.description: One source behind the gateway.

evaluationCases.name: gateway-sumsub-accepted
evaluationCases.description: Another source behind the gateway: same trust domain and attestor. Its lifetime is exactly the 365-day maximum.

evaluationCases.name: gateway-signed-signals-accepted
evaluationCases.description: Proof type 7 claim; the current signed-signals key's hash is registered to attestor 1.

evaluationCases.name: alias-accepted-individually
evaluationCases.description: The consumer allowlists a second host of the gateway operator under the same attestor.

evaluationCases.name: rotation-retired-key-within-window
evaluationCases.description: Rotation, proof type 4: evidence issued by the retired credential-root key before its notAfter stays valid (its root stays registered).

evaluationCases.name: replay-identical-redelivery
evaluationCases.description: Replay: the same evidenceId with identical fields is idempotent.

evaluationCases.name: evidence-id-scoped-by-trust-domain
evaluationCases.description: A revoked document from another trust domain that reuses this evidenceId does not affect it: observations are keyed by (trustDomainId, evidenceId).

evaluationCases.name: discovery-newer-than-observed
evaluationCases.description: A document newer than the one observed earlier replaces it.

evaluationCases.name: issued-within-clock-skew
evaluationCases.description: issuedAt 60 seconds ahead of the consumer's clock is tolerated.

evaluationCases.name: impostor-host-not-allowed
evaluationCases.description: A host outside the consumer's allowlist copying the gateway's attestor, root key and root: its documents alone would pass every later check.

evaluationCases.name: evidence-not-from-discovery-host
evaluationCases.description: Evidence obtained anywhere but the trust domain's own host (a push body, a relay, another provider) is unauthenticated.

evaluationCases.name: discovery-unavailable
evaluationCases.description: The discovery fetch failed (here 503) and the consumer holds no copy younger than revocationCheckSeconds.

evaluationCases.name: evidence-gone
evaluationCases.description: 410 Gone for a held evidenceId is final: the consumer records (trustDomainId, evidenceId) as revoked.

evaluationCases.name: evidence-not-found-is-unavailable
evaluationCases.description: 404 is unavailable, not revoked: refused for now and never recorded, so a provider misdeploy is recoverable.

evaluationCases.name: evidence-redirect-is-unavailable
evaluationCases.description: A consumer never follows redirects: a 3xx is unavailable.

evaluationCases.name: discovery-names-other-trust-domain
evaluationCases.description: An allowlisted host serving a document that names another trust domain.

evaluationCases.name: evidence-from-other-trust-domain
evaluationCases.description: Native evidence presented under the gateway's discovery document.

evaluationCases.name: discovery-duplicate-deployment
evaluationCases.description: Two attestors for one deployment in one document: one trust domain would count twice in a quorum.

evaluationCases.name: discovery-duplicate-key
evaluationCases.description: A keyId listed twice (here once revoked): first-match and last-match consumers would disagree.

evaluationCases.name: discovery-duplicate-source
evaluationCases.description: A sourceId listed twice.

evaluationCases.name: discovery-rolled-back
evaluationCases.description: A document older than one the consumer observed (a stale cache or rollback).

evaluationCases.name: replay-across-chains
evaluationCases.description: Base evidence presented to a Base Sepolia consumer.

evaluationCases.name: replay-across-oracles
evaluationCases.description: Right chain, different Oracle deployment.

evaluationCases.name: attestor-not-declared
evaluationCases.description: Native evidence claiming attestor 1 while the consumer pins the native trust domain to attestor 7.

evaluationCases.name: impostor-pinned-to-other-attestor
evaluationCases.description: The consumer onboarded the host as attestor 9; its documents claim attestor 1. The pin, not the document, decides.

evaluationCases.name: claim-type-not-declared
evaluationCases.description: human-tech declares personhood.unique only.

evaluationCases.name: policy-not-declared
evaluationCases.description: A policyId the source does not declare.

evaluationCases.name: key-not-declared
evaluationCases.description: keyId absent from discovery.

evaluationCases.name: key-use-mismatch
evaluationCases.description: A proof type 4 artifact naming a signed-signals key.

evaluationCases.name: rotation-revoked-key
evaluationCases.description: Key revocation is retroactive: issuedAt inside the key's window does not help.

evaluationCases.name: key-revocation-not-reversible
evaluationCases.description: A newer document that drops a key's revokedAt does not restore the key: the consumer remembers revocations per (trustDomainId, keyId).

evaluationCases.name: rotation-retired-key-after-window
evaluationCases.description: Rotation: the retired key cannot issue after its notAfter.

evaluationCases.name: rotation-retired-signals-key
evaluationCases.description: Rotation, proof types 7-9: a retired signed-signals key ends at notAfter, even for evidence issued inside its window and even while the Oracle still holds its hash.

evaluationCases.name: credential-signer-not-on-oracle
evaluationCases.description: The current credential-root key's credentialSigner is not the Oracle's getCredentialSigner for the attestor.

evaluationCases.name: revocation-root-revoked-on-oracle
evaluationCases.description: Revocation on-chain: the root is no longer valid for attestor 1.

evaluationCases.name: revocation-signer-hash-revoked-on-oracle
evaluationCases.description: Revocation on-chain: the signed-signals hash was revoked from the registry.

evaluationCases.name: replay-across-wallets
evaluationCases.description: Evidence for one wallet presented for another.

evaluationCases.name: replay-evidence-id-reused
evaluationCases.description: Same evidenceId, different immutable field (an in-place extension).

evaluationCases.name: revocation-status-revoked
evaluationCases.description: The provider reports the evidence revoked.

evaluationCases.name: revocation-not-reversible
evaluationCases.description: An active response after the consumer observed revoked.

evaluationCases.name: validity-window-empty
evaluationCases.description: expiresAt equal to issuedAt.

evaluationCases.name: validity-too-long
evaluationCases.description: expiresAt one second past the 365-day maximum lifetime.

evaluationCases.name: issued-in-future
evaluationCases.description: issuedAt 61 seconds ahead of the consumer's clock.

evaluationCases.name: expired
evaluationCases.description: expiresAt is exclusive: now == expiresAt is expired.

quorumCases.name: gateway-two-sources-one-trust-domain
quorumCases.description: Two KYC sources (persona, sumsub) re-signed by one gateway: one trust domain, one attestor, so 2-of-N is NOT met.
quorumCases.subject: 0xf39fd6e51aad88f6f4ce6ab8827279cfffb92266

quorumCases.name: native-and-gateway-two-trust-domains
quorumCases.description: One native and one gateway trust domain: two attestors, quorum met.
quorumCases.subject: 0xf39fd6e51aad88f6f4ce6ab8827279cfffb92266

quorumCases.name: three-sources-two-trust-domains
quorumCases.description: Three KYC sources across two trust domains count two.
quorumCases.subject: 0xf39fd6e51aad88f6f4ce6ab8827279cfffb92266

quorumCases.name: alias-host-shares-attestor
quorumCases.description: Two allowlisted hosts pinned to one Oracle providerId are one trust domain on-chain and count once.
quorumCases.subject: 0xf39fd6e51aad88f6f4ce6ab8827279cfffb92266

quorumCases.name: refused-member-not-counted
quorumCases.description: Only evidence that passes the section 10.5 evaluation counts.
quorumCases.subject: 0xf39fd6e51aad88f6f4ce6ab8827279cfffb92266

quorumCases.name: impostor-not-counted
quorumCases.description: A host outside the allowlist claiming the gateway's attestor adds nothing.
quorumCases.subject: 0xf39fd6e51aad88f6f4ce6ab8827279cfffb92266

quorumCases.name: claim-types-not-pooled
quorumCases.description: A personhood claim does not count toward a KYC requirement.
quorumCases.subject: 0xf39fd6e51aad88f6f4ce6ab8827279cfffb92266

quorumCases.name: multi-signed-two-trust-domains
quorumCases.description: Proof type 9 KYC from the native and the gateway trust domains: two attestors, quorum met.
quorumCases.subject: 0xf39fd6e51aad88f6f4ce6ab8827279cfffb92266

quorumCases.name: proof-types-not-pooled
quorumCases.description: A proof type 4 credential does not count toward a proof type 9 requirement.
quorumCases.subject: 0xf39fd6e51aad88f6f4ce6ab8827279cfffb92266
